To bless a wooden stake you need an ancient prayer spoken by ten priests, each in a different city. You buy a {item:Wooden Stake} from {npc:Gamon} in Thais and carry the stake from temple to temple across the mainland, receiving one line of the prayer in each. At the end you receive the {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} and, if you go to {npc:Chondur}, the achievement **Blessed!** and the possibility of blessing more stakes.
At the end of the quest, when you talk to Chondur in Meriana ({key:wooden stake}).
Blesses one of your own {item:Wooden Stake} per week (real time). You need the {wiki:Meriana Quest}.
To return to **Liberty Bay**, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
